collection.title: Skoda Kodiaq 2016 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Skoda Kodiaq 2016 - 2021 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Kodiaq which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
